summary: Iteration 16 — QR catalog + associate-qr tested. Backend 100% green (15/15 pytest). Frontend catalog admin tab OK. CRITICAL UI BUG: clicking qr-manual-toggle in QrAssociateDialog throws uncaught React 'removeChild' error, blocking the entire manual fallback flow (the only viable path in test env without camera).

ui_bugs.issue: Uncaught React runtime error 'Failed to execute removeChild on Node: The node to be removed is not a child of this node' fires when clicking qr-manual-toggle. Manual input UI never renders => qr-manual-input never appears => whole QR association flow (manual fallback) is unusable. Camera path also cannot be used in the test/preview env. Root cause: onClick={() => { stopScanner(); setManual(true); }} does not await stopScanner(). Html5Qrcode injects <video>/<canvas> children into #qr-reader-region; setManual(true) synchronously re-renders and React tries to unmount that div while html5-qrcode is still asynchronously clearing children => DOM tree becomes inconsistent with React's virtual DOM.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot exercise end-to-end because manual-toggle crash aborts the flow. Backend endpoint itself works (proven via pytest).

action_items: Fix QrAssociateDialog.jsx line 119 onClick: await stopScanner() before setManual(true). Simplest fix: onClick={async () => { await stopScanner(); setManual(true); }}. Alternative (safer): always keep the reader <div id={READER_ID}> mounted in the DOM (only visually hidden via CSS when manual=true) so React never unmounts a subtree that html5-qrcode is still manipulating.
Consider a similar await pattern in the useEffect cleanup at line 58 to avoid stray unmount races.
Also start-scanner useEffect calls startScanner even when manual is toggled inside the same render — after fix, verify the camera-off path is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py associate-qr correctly strips 'ZONECLIMATE:' prefix, tolerates absence, forces gainable to master zone, rejects duplicates and unknown codes, hides tuya_id/product_id from response. Good.

QrAssociateDialog: stopScanner is async but is fired-and-forgotten inside a synchronous onClick that immediately toggles React state — direct cause of the removeChild crash. Requires await.

rca of the issue: Bug: qr-manual-toggle button triggers 'Failed to execute removeChild on Node'. Reproduction: login installateur@demo.fr, open any writable installation → Appareils tab → click open-qr-scan-btn → click qr-manual-toggle. Result: React overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors' (dev) and manual-input never mounts. Cause: html5-qrcode injects DOM children into #qr-reader-region during startScanner; when setManual(true) fires before the async stop/clear completes, React unmounts the reader div, and html5-qrcode later tries to remove children that are no longer part of that node. Mitigation: await stopScanner() in the onClick, or keep the reader div mounted at all times (hidden via CSS when manual=true).
